payload.text: **17 (hv, 2026-09-18 11:59Z) -- 0088 row 2, second amendment; supersedes 15.** dc measured that decision 15 handed the terminal to every tool a devbin function starts (mix under check format, intent critic, the formatters, fullcycle's phases), because the check looked only at the gate's first word. Every gate's tool gets </dev/null again. run_gate exports DEVBIN_GATE_TTY=1 when its own stdin is a terminal, and _clean_confirm asks on '-t 0 or that flag', still behind -r /dev/tty. That keeps one rule at one site.
